Add shell helpers for the Docker objects the author inspects most often: containers and volumes, alongside the `images` helper that already existed. The title is the whole note; the intent is a short word per object type that lists it without the header line and offers the couple of variants (all, clean) that `docker ps` / `docker volume ls` need flags for.
